title: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
authors: Peter Ganong, Avik Garg, Maximilian Kasy
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect—after correcting for selectivity—is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.

title: Exact inference from finite market data
title_zh: 有限市场数据的精确推断
authors: F. Kübler, R. Malhotra, H. Polemarchakis
abstract: Abstract We derive conditions for individual choices and $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium prices to be inferred from a finite set of market data in the following sense: Although potential observations are infinite, inference can be attained and known to have been attained after a finite number of observations. While we first examine the case of observations on an individual’s demand at different prices and incomes, our primary focus is on equilibrium, where only profiles of individual endowments and associated equilibrium prices are observable. Our main result is that finite inference is possible in the equilibrium setting if one wants to infer either individual choices or the $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium correspondence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文推导了从有限市场数据推断个体选择与ε-均衡价格的条件，其含义如下：尽管潜在观测数据是无限的，但经过有限次观测后，推断不仅能够实现，且可被确认为已完成。我们首先考察了不同价格与收入水平下个体需求观测的情形，但主要关注均衡状态——此时仅能观测到个体禀赋组合及其对应的均衡价格。核心结论是：若需推断个体选择或ε-均衡对应关系，则在均衡框架下有限次推断是可行的。

title: Persuasion with Coarse Communication
abstract: Abstract In many expert–decision maker settings, information is richer than the language used to convey it. Motivated by this communication friction, we study Bayesian persuasion when the sender is constrained to use k messages. We show that the sender’s value is given by a k -point analogue of concavification, which we call k -concavification. An optimal information structure can be chosen with affinely independent posterior support, allowing the problem to be reduced to a lower-dimensional persuasion problem and then solved by standard concavification. We derive a tight bound on the value of communication capacity that applies to general persuasion games: the gain from a $$(k+1)$$ ( k + 1 ) st message is at most $$2/(k-1)$$ 2 / ( k - 1 ) times the value attainable with k messages. Finally, we solve a class of belief-threshold games in which the receiver chooses between a safe default and several risky actions, the sender gets zero from the default and the same positive payoff from any risky action, and a risky action is taken only when the corresponding posterior probability exceeds a threshold. We characterize the optimal coarse information structure, derive comparative statics in the prior and the threshold, and extend the analysis to heterogeneous thresholds and heterogeneous sender values across risky actions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多专家与决策者互动的场景中，信息本身比用于传递信息的语言更为丰富。受这种沟通摩擦的启发，我们研究了当发送者被限制使用k条消息时的贝叶斯说服问题。我们证明，发送者的价值由凹化概念的k点对应物给出，我们称之为k-凹化。最优信息结构可以选择具有仿射独立后验支撑的形式，从而将问题简化为低维说服问题，并通过标准凹化方法求解。我们推导了适用于一般说服博弈的沟通容量价值的紧界：第(k+1)条消息带来的增益最多为k条消息可实现价值的2/(k-1)倍。最后，我们求解了一类信念阈值博弈，其中接收者在安全默认选项与多个风险行动之间进行选择，发送者从默认选项中获得零收益，从任何风险行动中获得相同的正收益，且仅当相应的后验概率超过阈值时才采取风险行动。我们刻画了最优粗糙信息结构，推导了关于先验和阈值的比较静态分析，并将分析扩展至风险行动具有异质性阈值和异质性发送者价值的情形。

title: A Static Capital Buffer is Hard To Beat
title_zh: 静态资本缓冲难以被超越
authors: Matthew Canzoneri, Behzad Diba, Luca Guerrieri, Arsenii Mishin
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In a model with endogenous risk-taking, deposit insurance and limited liability may lead banks to make risky loans that are socially inefficient. Capital requirements can prevent excessive risk-taking at the cost of reducing liquidity-producing bank deposits. A policy that sets capital requirements just high enough to prevent excessive risktaking will move capital requirements pro-, counter-, or a-cyclically depending on the shock source. However, such a policy requires full knowledge of all the shocks hitting the economy and is not implementable. Simple rules that respond to cyclical conditions—in line with Basel III guidance—perform poorly, whereas a small static capital buffer can do much better.
abstract_zh: 在内生风险承担模型中，存款保险与有限责任可能导致银行发放社会效率低下的高风险贷款。资本充足要求能够以降低流动性创造型银行存款为代价，防止过度风险承担。若将资本充足要求设定为恰好足以遏制过度风险承担的水平，该政策将根据冲击来源呈现顺周期、逆周期或非周期特征。然而，此类政策要求完全掌握冲击经济的全部因素，实际中并不可行。符合《巴塞尔协议III》指引的周期性调节型简单规则表现欠佳，而小规模静态资本缓冲却能取得显著更优效果。

title: Beliefs About the Economy are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data
title_zh: 家庭层面冲击对经济信念的过度敏感：基于关联调查与行政数据的证据
authors: Dmitry Taubinsky, Luigi Butera, Matteo Saccarola, Chen Lian
abstract: Abstract We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, utilizing a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (“backcasts” ), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which utilize data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.
